summary.para: The sort values of the service account, returned when the request has a sort.
When the account was created, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent for an account that was created before Elasticsearch recorded its creation time.
The user who created the account. Absent for an account that was created before Elasticsearch recorded its creator.
The profile UID of the user who created the account. Returned only when with_profile_uid is true and that user has an activated user profile.
A free-text description of the account, as sent on the last PUT of the account. It has no meaning to Elasticsearch. Absent when the account has no description.
The names of the roles granted to the account, as sent on the last PUT of the account. They are resolved when the account authenticates.
The account was created with the put user-managed service account API.
When the account was last replaced, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent until the account is first replaced.
The user who last replaced the account with the put user-managed service account API. Absent until the account is first replaced.
The profile UID of the user who last replaced the account. Returned only when with_profile_uid is true and that user has an activated user profile.
The name of the service account, as namespace/service.
